title: 第023章 林间初现黑衣影第024章 剑气侵体女剑修
lines: 解决了五名黑风寨的杀手，马车重新上路，但气氛已截然不同。车夫老汉握着缰绳的手还在微微发抖，不时紧张地回头张望，仿佛那幽暗的树林里随时会再窜出索命的黑影。阿萝也紧紧靠着车厢壁，脸色发白，但眼神中除了紧张，更多了一丝与年龄不符的警惕和思考。她亲眼目睹了秦夜如何干净利落地解决那些凶狠的杀手，心中的震撼和钦佩无以复加，但也更深刻地理解了秦夜所说的“危险”和“麻烦”意味着什么。
秦夜坐在车厢内，闭目调息，看似平静，实则神识完全放开，如同无形的蛛网，感知着马车周围数十丈范围内的风吹草动。体内《九转生死诀》缓缓运转，消化着刚才短暂战斗带来的消耗，也吸收着天地间游离的、比青云城浓郁些许的灵气。这片山林区域，灵气似乎比平原城镇要活跃一些。
“黑风寨……贺彪……”秦夜心中思忖。对方派出五名淬体三重的杀手，算是下了本钱，显然是想要一击必杀。但自己展现出的实力，恐怕超出了他们的预估。消息传回去后，黑风寨会如何反应？是知难而退，还是恼羞成怒，派出更强的高手？
不管是哪种，这黑风寨，都已经是敌人了。而且，对方既然能准确掌握他们的行踪，在这片区域必然有眼线。接下来的路，必须更加小心。
“车把式，前面找个靠近水源、相对开阔又能藏车的地方停下，今晚就在那里过夜。”秦夜睁开眼睛，对车外吩咐道。天色渐晚，夜间赶路更加危险，而且阿萝也需要休息，她的腿伤不能长时间颠簸。
“哎，好，好。”车夫连忙应下，更加仔细地观察着路旁。
又前行了约莫小半个时辰，在一条清澈的小溪旁，找到了一处背靠山壁、前有溪流、两侧林木不算太茂密的空地。空地一侧还有个天然的石凹，勉强能遮挡风雨，正好可以将马车藏在里面。
马车停下，车夫手脚麻利地卸下马匹，牵到溪边饮水喂料。秦夜搀扶阿萝下车，让她坐在一块干净的大石上休息。他自己则快速在周围巡视了一圈，确认没有近期人类或大型野兽活动的痕迹，并在几个关键方位布下了简单的预警机关——用细线串联铃铛，或者用枯枝巧妙架设，一旦被触动就会发出声响。
做完这些，他才在溪边生了堆火，架上小锅，煮了些米粥，又将之前从醉仙楼顺来的酱肉切了些放进去。很快，食物的香气弥漫开来，驱散了几分林间的寒意和紧张。
“秦大哥，那些黑风寨的人，还会再来吗？”阿萝捧着热粥，小口喝着，忍不住问道。
“可能会，也可能不会。”秦夜吃着东西，目光扫过跳动的火光，“损失了五名好手，他们需要重新评估我的实力。如果那个三当家贺彪是个谨慎的人，或许会暂时观望，或者提高悬赏，让别的亡命徒来试探。如果他是个鲁莽易怒的，可能会亲自带人来。”
“那……我们怎么办？”阿萝担忧地问。黑风寨听起来就是个凶恶的匪窝，肯定比城主府的护卫更难对付。
“兵来将挡，水来土掩。”秦夜语气平淡，“他们若来，杀了便是。正好，我也需要实战来磨砺修为，巩固境界。”
他看着阿萝眼中依旧未散的忧色，补充道：“阿萝，记住，恐惧解决不了问题，只会让你失去判断力。无论面对什么敌人，首先要冷静，观察，寻找对方的弱点和自己的优势。就像你的腿伤，看起来是弱点，但在某些特定情况下，或许也能让对方麻痹大意。”
阿萝若有所思地点点头，努力压下心中的不安。她知道秦大哥说得对，自己必须尽快成长起来，不能总是依赖秦大哥的保护，更不能成为拖累。
吃完饭，秦夜让阿萝继续尝试吐纳，自己则走到溪流上游一点的地方，找了块平坦的巨石，盘膝坐下。他没有立刻修炼，而是从怀中取出了那几块从杀手身上搜到的黑色狼头令牌，在手中摩挲着。
令牌材质是一种沉手的黑木，入手微凉，正面雕刻的狼头栩栩如生，獠牙外露，眼神凶厉。背面则是简单的编号。制作不算特别精良，但透着股草莽的凶悍气。
“黑风寨……看来不只是普通的乌合之众，有点门道。”秦夜将令牌收起。这种制式令牌，说明黑风寨内部有一定的组织和等级。能培养出淬体三重的专业杀手，其资源和人脉恐怕也不简单。贺彪一个三当家就能调动这样的力量，那大当家、二当家，又该是什么实力？
他正沉思间，耳朵忽然微微一动。
不是预警机关的声响，而是……风声中夹杂的一丝极其微弱的、不同于夜枭或小兽的振翅声。那声音很轻，频率特殊，若非他神识敏锐，几乎无法察觉。
他缓缓抬起头，目光锐利地扫向侧后方一片漆黑茂密的山林。
夜色已深，月光被云层遮挡，林间光线昏暗。但在秦夜远超常人的目力下，他还是隐约看到，在数十丈外一棵大树的树冠阴影中，似乎有什么东西，极其轻微地动了一下。
不是人。体积很小，动作灵活。
秦夜不动声色，指尖悄然捻起一颗岸边的小石子。
就在这时，那树冠阴影中的东西，似乎完成了观察，悄无声息地滑出，借着夜色的掩护，如同一道淡淡的黑烟，朝着他们宿营地的方向，悄无声息地飘来。
速度不快，但轨迹飘忽，带着一种刻意的小心和隐匿。
不是野兽。野兽不会有这种目的性明确的侦察行为。
是驯养的飞禽？还是……某种用于侦查的机关造物？
秦夜眼神一冷。看来，除了黑风寨，还有别的“客人”在暗中窥视。而且，手段更加隐秘和……专业。
他没有立刻出手打草惊蛇。他想看看，这玩意儿到底想干什么，背后又是谁在操控。
那黑影在距离宿营地约莫二十丈左右的一棵矮树上停了下来，完美地融入枝叶阴影中，一动不动，仿佛与树木融为一体。若非秦夜一直锁定着它，几乎无法发现它的存在。
“阿萝，进马车里去，无论听到什么，不要出来。”秦夜的声音，平静地传入正在努力吐纳的阿萝耳中。
阿萝心头一凛，没有任何犹豫，立刻停止吐纳，用最快的速度，拖着伤腿，艰难地挪进了马车车厢，并将车门关好。车夫也吓得连忙缩到石凹更深处。
秦夜依旧坐在巨石上，仿佛毫无所觉，甚至闭上了眼睛，像是进入了修炼状态。但他全身的肌肉，已经调整到最适宜爆发的状态，神识如同最精密的雷达，牢牢锁定着那二十丈外的黑影，以及黑影可能存在的、更远处的操控者。
时间一分一秒过去。林间寂静，只有溪水潺潺和柴火偶尔的噼啪声。
那黑影在矮树上停留了约莫一盏茶的时间，似乎确认了目标的位置和状态。然后，它再次动了。
这一次，它不是靠近，而是悄无声息地向后滑退，显然是想回去报信。
content_en:
After solving the five killers of Black Wind Village, the carriage was back on the road, but the atmosphere was completely different. The old coachman's hand holding the reins was still trembling slightly, and he looked back nervously from time to time, as if another black shadow threatening death would emerge from the dark woods at any time. A Luo also leaned against the wall of the carriage, her face pale, but in addition to nervousness, her eyes also contained a hint of vigilance and thinking that was inconsistent with her age. She witnessed with her own eyes how Qin Ye dealt with those vicious killers cleanly and neatly. She was filled with shock and admiration, but she also had a deeper understanding of what Qin Ye meant by "danger" and "trouble."
Qin Ye sat in the carriage, closing his eyes and regulating his breath. He seemed calm, but in fact, his consciousness was completely relaxed, like an invisible spider web, sensing the movement within a few dozen feet around the carriage. The "Nine Revolutions of Life and Death" in the body is slowly rotating, digesting the consumption caused by the short battle just now, and also absorbing the spiritual energy floating between heaven and earth, which is slightly richer than Qingyun City. In this mountainous forest area, the spiritual energy seems to be more active than in the plain towns.
"Black Wind Village... He Biao..." Qin Ye thought in his heart. The other party sent out five killers of the third level of body tempering, which was considered a capital investment, and they obviously wanted to kill them with one blow. But the strength he showed may have exceeded their expectations. How will Heifeng Village react after the news spreads back? Should he retreat when faced with difficulties, or become angry and send out stronger experts?
No matter what it is, this Black Wind Village is already an enemy. Moreover, since the other party can accurately grasp their whereabouts, they must have spies in this area. You must be more careful on the road ahead.
"Handlebar type, find a place in front of the car that is close to the water source, relatively open and can hide the car. We will spend the night there tonight." Qin Ye opened his eyes and gave instructions to the outside of the car. It was getting late, and it was more dangerous to travel at night. Moreover, A Luo also needed to rest. Her leg injury could not allow her to ride for a long time.
"Hey, okay, okay." The coachman responded quickly and looked at the roadside more carefully.
After walking forward for about half an hour, we found an open space next to a clear stream with a mountain wall at its back, a stream in front of it, and not too dense trees on both sides. There is also a natural stone depression on one side of the open space, which can barely block the wind and rain, and can just be used to hide the carriage inside.
The carriage stopped, and the driver quickly unloaded the horses and led them to the stream for drinking water and feeding. Qin Ye helped A Luo get out of the car and asked her to sit on a clean boulder to rest. He himself quickly patrolled the surroundings to confirm that there were no traces of recent human or large beast activity, and set up simple early warning mechanisms in several key locations - bells connected in series with thin wires, or cleverly erected with dead branches, which would make a sound once they were touched.
After doing this, he lit a fire by the stream, set up a small pot, cooked some rice porridge, and cut some of the sauced meat that he had received from Zuixian Tower before and put it in. Soon, the aroma of food spread, dispelling some of the chill and tension in the forest.
"Brother Qin, will those people from Black Wind Village come again?" A Luo couldn't help but ask, holding the hot porridge in her hand and sipping it in small sips.
"Maybe, maybe not." Qin Ye ate and glanced at the dancing firelight. "They have lost five good players. They need to re-evaluate my strength. If the third leader He Biao is a cautious person, he may wait and see for the time being, or raise the reward and let other desperadoes test it. If he is reckless and irritable, he may bring people here himself."
"Then... what should we do?" A Luo asked worriedly. Black Wind Village sounds like a vicious gangster's den, and it must be more difficult to deal with than the guards of the City Lord's Mansion.
"When soldiers come, they will be blocked, and when water comes, the earth will cover them." Qin Ye said calmly, "If they come, just kill them. It just so happens that I also need actual combat to hone my cultivation and consolidate my realm."
He looked at the still lingering worry in A Luo's eyes and added: "A Luo, remember, fear can't solve the problem, it will only make you lose your judgment. No matter what enemy you face, you must first be calm, observe, and look for the opponent's weaknesses and your own strengths. Just like your leg injury, it may seem like a weakness, but under certain circumstances, it may also make the opponent paralyzed."
A Luo nodded thoughtfully, trying to suppress the uneasiness in her heart. She knows that Brother Qin is right. She must grow up as soon as possible. She cannot always rely on Brother Qin's protection, let alone become a drag.
After eating, Qin Ye let A Luo continue to try to breathe, while he walked to a place a little upstream of the stream, found a flat boulder, and sat down cross-legged. He did not practice immediately, but took out the few black wolf head tokens found from the killer from his arms and rubbed them in his hands.
The material of the token is a kind of heavy black wood, which is slightly cool to the touch. The wolf head carved on the front is lifelike, with exposed fangs and fierce eyes. On the back is a simple number. It's not particularly well-made, but it has a rough and fierce air.
"Heifeng Village...it seems like they are not just an ordinary mob, they have some skills." Qin Ye put away the token. This kind of standard token shows that there is a certain organization and level within Heifeng Village. The resources and connections that can cultivate a professional killer at the third level of body tempering are probably not simple. He Biao can mobilize such power as the third master. What strength should the first and second masters have?
While he was deep in thought, his ears suddenly moved slightly.
It wasn't the sound of an early warning agency, but... an extremely weak sound mixed with the sound of the wind that was different from the flapping of the wings of a night owl or a small beast. The sound was very soft and had a special frequency. If he didn't have a keen sense of consciousness, it would be almost impossible to detect it.
He slowly raised his head and glanced sharply at the dark and dense mountain forest behind him.
The night was already dark, the moonlight was blocked by clouds, and the light in the forest was dim. But with Qin Ye's far superior vision, he still vaguely saw that something seemed to be moving very slightly in the shadow of the crown of a big tree dozens of feet away.
Not a human being. Small in size and flexible in movement.
Qin Ye remained calm and quietly picked up a pebble from the shore with his fingertips.
At this moment, the thing in the shadow of the tree crown seemed to have completed its observation and slipped out silently. Under the cover of the night, it floated silently towards their campsite like a faint black smoke.
The speed is not fast, but the trajectory is erratic, with a deliberate caution and concealment.
Not a beast. Wild beasts do not engage in such purposeful reconnaissance.
Is it a domesticated bird? Or... some kind of machine creation used for investigation?
Qin Ye's eyes turned cold. It seems that besides Heifeng Village, there are other "guests" peeping in secret. Moreover, the methods are more secretive and...professional.
He did not immediately act to alert the enemy. He wanted to see what this thing was trying to do and who was behind it.
The black shadow stopped on a short tree about twenty feet away from the campsite, blending perfectly into the shadow of the branches and leaves, motionless, as if it had merged with the tree. If Qin Ye hadn't locked onto it all the time, it would have been almost impossible to discover its existence.
"A'luo, get in the carriage. No matter what you hear, don't come out." Qin Ye's voice calmly reached A'luo's ears, who was trying to breathe.
A Luo's heart trembled, and without any hesitation, she immediately stopped vomiting, dragged her injured leg as quickly as possible, struggled to move into the carriage compartment, and closed the door. The driver was so frightened that he quickly retreated deeper into the stone recess.
Qin Ye was still sitting on the boulder, as if he didn't notice anything. He even closed his eyes, as if he had entered a state of cultivation. But the muscles all over his body have been adjusted to the most suitable state for explosion, and his consciousness is like the most sophisticated radar, firmly locking on the black shadow twenty feet away, as well as the shadow's possible controller further away.
Time passed by minute by minute. The forest was silent except for the gurgling stream and the occasional crackle of firewood.
The black shadow stayed on the short tree for about the time of a cup of tea, seemingly confirming the target's location and status. Then, it moved again.
This time, instead of approaching, it slid back silently, apparently wanting to go back and report the news.
title_en: Chapter 023 A black-clothed shadow first appears in the forest Chapter 024 The sword energy invades the body of the female swordsman
